definition: a small emblem that shows your rank or membership
description: A hamster in a pink bow spends a day as an office worker. It sits in a big black office chair at a desk covered in papers with a photo ID badge hanging round its neck on a lanyard, yawns hugely and then dozes off. It fills a small white cup at an office coffee machine, sits on a toilet holding a roll of paper under a framed FOCUS FLUSH FINISH sign, then at five o'clock jumps up at the card reader beside the office door with its badge and walks out through the glass door into the sunset.

en.question: What is hanging around the hamster's neck?

de.answer: Um seinen Hals hängt ein Ausweis.
de.question: Was hängt um den Hals des Hamsters?

es.answer: Una tarjeta de identificación cuelga de su cuello.
es.question: ¿Qué cuelga del cuello del hámster?

fr.answer: Un badge pend autour de son cou.
fr.question: Qu'est-ce qui pend autour du cou du hamster ?
